mapper.select: SELECT o.*, d.name AS device_name, d.device_no, ur.real_name AS reporter_name, uh.real_name AS handler_name FROM repair_order o LEFT JOIN device d ON o.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user ur ON o.reporter_id = ur.id LEFT JOIN user uh ON o.handler_id = uh.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT MAX(order_no) FROM repair_order WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT('RO', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repair_order (order_no, device_id, reporter_id, handler_id, title, description, photo_name, status, handle_remark, assign_time, finish_time, accept_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{deviceId}, #{reporterId}, #{handlerId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{photoName}, #{status}, #{handleRemark}, #{assignTime}, #{finishTime}, #{acceptTime}, NOW(), NOW())
